verification: Initial evaluations identical within each seed, and all evaluation queries identical; fixed last checkpoints, budgets checked. Eight development layouts per split, two fixed seeds; paired layout intervals do not quantify training seed population uncertainty. Null witness distances mean proven unreachable.
limitation: Only eight original training layouts are used repeatedly in these small fitting studies, while initialization previously used 1000 layouts. Domain forgetting is a hypothesis to test with permitted original training relations; not established as the sole cause. Connected neighborhoods are root-anchored, with limited root-layer coverage per batch.
